title: Excited to Serve the Lord
verse: Moses summoned Bezalel and Oholiab and every skilled person in whom the Lord had put skill—everyone whose heart stirred him to volunteer to do the work.
observation: In today’s chapter, the people of God were finally ready to build the place where they would worship. Bezalel and Oholiab were excited to serve in designing the tools for worship. In today’s culture, people are far more likely to be excited about watching other people worship. They come to church to either receive for themselves or to be entertained. These two men were excited to serve the Lord by serving His people. They had realized that it is a greater blessing to serve. Also, we don’t serve people for the sake of the people. We serve people for the sake of the Lord. When He is the object of our affection, it does not matter how people respond. It is all for the LORD.
application: Where can you serve in your local church community? Look for a way to serve and be excited to serve the Lord by serving His people. It is all for Him.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for letting us be a part of Your kingdom.
